text: You're looking for a dish that's creamy, cheesy, and satisfying, but also mindful of your calorie goals. I think I have just the thing for you. This Cornbread Pudding Cake, or Tomalito, is a creative twist on a classic cornbread recipe. It's made with a mix, which saves time, and has a lovely creamy texture from the milk and melted butter. Plus, it's ready in under 35 minutes, fitting your time budget. At 248 calories per serving, it's a relatively guilt-free indulgence that should fit into your health goals. Give it a try!
